about: Canonical JSON test vectors for .crbm generation metadata. The canonical form is RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) restricted to one flat object of string and finite-number values: keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit, strings escaped as ECMAScript JSON.stringify escapes them, numbers written as ECMAScript Number.prototype.toString writes them, no whitespace. Each vector gives a JSON text (input), the canonical text a writer must produce from the values it parses to (canonical), and that text in UTF-8 as hex (canonicalUtf8Hex), which is what a .crbm 1.1 metadata section holds. A reader accepts the canonical bytes and refuses the input bytes, which are not canonical.

vectors.name: keys: integer-like keys sort as strings, not as numbers
keys: by UTF-16 code unit, so a non-BMP key sorts before U+FF01 (code-point order would put it after)
numbers: -0, exponents and their boundaries, the largest safe integer, the smallest subnormal
strings: the escapes JSON.stringify writes, and the characters it leaves as they are
